shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: player-configurable 1-3 sky levels above (each a shrinking-ledge mountain) + surface + solid rock basement, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/needs/medical/prisoners, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF, Rimefeller) across the whole column, stairs/ladders/elevators, level-switch UI, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels: the surface, one solid-rock basement below, and a PLAYER-CONFIGURABLE 1-3 sky levels above (setting `maxUpperLevels`, default 1, hard-clamped to 3). Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from a sky level with a live view of the level directly below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED across BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller).
- **Detection is postfix-insensitive** via ABDetect.Active. HarmonyBoot filters on [HarmonyPatch].
- **1.6 render model (MEASURED)**: TerrainHard base 2000; terrain MATERIAL queue = 2000 + renderPrecedence; Cutout atlas 2900; EdgeShadow 2950. Terrain SHADER is set by TerrainDef.edgeType: Hard→TerrainHard, Fade→TerrainFade, FadeRough→TerrainFadeRough, Water→TerrainWater. In user lore (textures).
- **Level cap is a setting**: up to `maxUpperLevels` (1-3) sky levels + surface + one basement. Old one-up/one-down cap lifted in FOUR gates (LevelMapGen.GetOrGenerate, Building_ABStairs.EstablishLink, Building_ABElevator.AddDirection, PlaceWorker_ABStairs) reading ABMod.Settings.MaxUpper. Default 1 preserves prior behavior/old saves. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- **Construction over natural rock is left VANILLA** — mine rooms first.

## Stacked sky levels (configurable 1-3 up)
- **Relative-neighbour architecture**: everything operates on a map's immediate `UpperMap()`/`LowerMap()` and chains through the per-map linked list; `MapByLevel` (ground controller) holds the whole column.
- **Ledge shrinks per level (USER-VERIFIED in-game)**: GenStep_ABSkyTerrain projects the mountain mass from the level DIRECTLY BELOW (passed via `LevelMapGen.Context.belowMap` = sourceMap, since links are wired AFTER gen and LowerMap() is null during the genstep). Each step up erodes one more ring → shrinking ziggurat, and fogs like vanilla unexplored mountain. Falls back to GroundMap() for the first sky level.
- **Per-level sky ticks** generalized `level == 1` → `level > 0` in LevelComp; ClimatePatches.SkyGroundOrNull `level != 1` → `level <= 0`. Each sky level mirrors from its immediate lower neighbour; state propagates up the stack.
- **Sky-only section layers generalized** `level == 1` → `level <= 0` (draw on ALL sky levels): SectionLayer_ABMountainCap, SectionLayer_ABWallReveal, SectionLayer_ABWallFacade — so +2/+3 get their fog-cap and slab detailing, not just +1.
- **Vanilla power self-bridges per pair** (CompABGridLink), so +1<->+2 power crossed with NO change.

## Stacked see-below RED-RENDER FIXES (USER-FOUND, two distinct shader bugs, both ROOT-CAUSED)
With 1 sky level the map drawn "below" was always the ground (hard rock terrain on the verified test map), so neither bug surfaced. With stacking:
- **(1) Sky-below-sky ShadowMask (levels above +1)**: the map below a sky level is ITSELF a sky level (+2 viewing +1), whose open-air cells use `dontRender` terrain (AB_OpenAir) that SectionLayer_Terrain bakes with `MatBases.ShadowMask` — a stencil/mask material, NOT visible color. Drawn flat as below-content → solid RED. FIX: LevelRenderer.DrawSections skips `sub.material == MatBases.ShadowMask` (those cells read as empty holes; the see-below only reaches one level down).
- **(2) FadeRough terrain shader (the ground seen from +1)**: the natural ground (soil/grass/sand) uses `edgeType FadeRough` → the `Map/TerrainFadeRough` shader, which samples per-map edge/fade state only the CURRENT map's render pass establishes — drawn for a non-current map (the see-below) it renders as solid RED. Hard-edged terrain (the sky levels' AB_MountainTop/AB_RoofSurface) is fine. FIX: BelowMaterialFor swaps `TerrainFade`/`TerrainFadeRough`/`TerrainFadeRoughPolluted` → `ShaderDatabase.TerrainHard` in the clone (same texture, crisp edges, safe cross-map). Water (TerrainWater) is left alone (its globals are re-pointed each frame by DrawBelowStatic).

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (whole-column bridging)
- ABPipeCompat/LevelClimate TickGroundPairs enumerate the WHOLE column via `LevelComp.CollectColumnStairs` and bridge each pair ONCE from its lower end (skip when `b.Map.Level() <= a.Map.Level()`) — so +1<->+2 utility/climate pairs bridge. Ground-branch tick keeps driving when `HasMultiLevels` even if the ground holds no stairs.
- Vanilla power conduit; VEF PipeSystem duct (VPE/Helixien/VTE); DBH water pipe; Rimefeller chem pipe (USER-VERIFIED).

## Sky surface + see-below renderer
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop; COVERED-BELOW rule + time-sliced sweep. Things PRINTED PER CELL (SectionLayer_ABBelowThings), faux-perspective depth, slab skirt, fake zoom out, rim wall reveal, wall facade. Every SectionLayer resolves `map.LowerMap()`, so +2 renders +1, +1 renders ground.
- LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView keeps camera pos+zoom (all immediate-neighbour). ABArchitectPreserve keeps the build tool across switches. LevelCamera.FollowPawn rides a selected colonist through stairs.

## Column-wide aggregations (whole stack)
- Storyteller wealth + pawns (ColumnWorld), trade beacons (ColumnTrade), settlement-loss headcount (SettlementLossGuard) iterate `LevelComp.LinkedLevelMaps()` — keeps the wealth-hiding exploit closed and lets +2/+3 goods sell.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics, needs, medical, prisoner transport, one-colony UI (colonist bar / pawn+animal tables / alerts iterate MapByLevel). **Cross-level logistics/caravan stay SINGLE-HOP (per-pawn immediate neighbours)**; caravan lists only the two adjacent levels.

## Performance
- Elapsed-time nextDue scheduling; hidden-level throttling; bridges run once from the ground comp over a reused buffer; zero recurring cost with no levels. **TPS with stacking is LINEAR in map count** — each extra sky level is one more full simulated Map.

## Mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes, DBH, Rimefeller (USER-VERIFIED), Open The Windows, Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver. XML: ABStairsExtension; ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip; async mask lag. Below-view reaches only ONE level down: a sky level's own open-air cells, seen from the level above, read as empty holes. Soft-terrain edges render crisp (not faded) in the see-below (shader swap).
- Construction over natural rock rejected everywhere (vanilla lock) — mine rooms first.
- Cross-level logistics single-hop; caravan lists only adjacent levels.
- Each enabled sky level is a full map's tick cost even when empty.

## Status
2026-07-20: configurable 1-3 sky levels. USER-VERIFIED in-game: ledge shrinks one ring per level and fogs; the +2/+3 red (ShadowMask) is GONE. Just fixed the SECOND red bug — the ground (soil = FadeRough shader) rendering red in +1's see-below — by swapping Fade/FadeRough terrain shaders to TerrainHard in the below-clone; building green, AWAITING in-game re-verification (the soil below +1 should now render normally, not red). Default maxUpperLevels=1 preserves prior behavior. Open: verify the FadeRough fix; +1<->+2 utilities; multi-level TPS; T9 soak; T5 publishing.
